---
name: Data source proposal
about: Propose a new official catchment, admissions, or statistics source
title: "[Data source] "
labels: data-source
---

**Local authority or publisher**

**Source type** (catchment / admissions / statistics)

**Official URL**

**Licence** (must be an explicit, reuse-compatible licence, e.g. Open Government Licence)

**Format** (GeoJSON / Shapefile ZIP / GeoPackage / KML / CSV with WKT / ArcGIS REST Feature Service / JSON endpoint)

**Coordinate reference system, if known**

**Why this source is official** (link to the publishing authority's own page, not a third-party aggregator)

Sources without a clear reuse licence, or that require scraping an interactive map with no documented API, will not be accepted. See docs/data-sources.md.
